connection.metricsWhenConnected: Traffic figures appear once the VPN is on.
connection.needsActivation: This device needs an activation code before it can connect.
connection.requiresSetup: Locus cannot turn the VPN on yet: it needs permission, and its helper service is not installed. Locus will ask for that permission when it starts — approve the prompt, then try again.
connection.blockerServiceInstallRequired: Locus cannot turn the VPN on yet: its helper service is not installed, and the permission prompt to install it was dismissed, denied, or never appeared. Quit and reopen Locus, then approve the prompt when it appears. If no prompt appears at all, reinstall Locus, then approve the prompt.
connection.blockerServiceUnavailable: Locus cannot turn the VPN on yet: its helper service is installed but not working ({{reason}}). Quit and reopen Locus to repair it. If that does not work, reinstall Locus.
connection.blockerServiceOperationInFlight: Locus is setting up its helper service. This takes a moment — wait for the prompt or for this message to clear, then try again.
connection.subscriptionLapsed: Your Locus subscription has expired, so the VPN will not connect. Contact the person who sold you the code to renew it.
connection.subscriptionExpiresToday: Your Locus subscription expires today. Contact the person who sold you the code to renew it.
connection.subscriptionExpiresIn: Your Locus subscription expires in {{count}} days. Contact the person who sold you the code to renew it.

account.expiresSoon: Your subscription expires soon. Contact the person who sold you the code to renew.
account.noExpiryYet: Your subscription end date is not available yet. It will appear after this device next contacts Locus.
account.activateForExpiry: Activate this device to see your subscription.
account.deviceIdHint: Quote the device ID if you need support — it identifies this install without revealing anything about you.
account.themeHint: Sets the look of the app. Leave it on Default to keep following the appearance setting above.
account.refreshBusy: A status read was already running
account.notActivated: This device is not activated. Enter the code from your card to connect.
account.storedCodeDamaged: The sign-in saved on this computer is damaged and could not be used, so Locus is asking you to enter your code again. Your plan and its remaining time are not affected.
account.notActivatedToCheck: Activate a code first — there is nothing to confirm yet.
account.updateCheckOff: Automatic update checking is off, so Locus is not being told about new versions. Turn it on above to receive fixes.
account.updateBlocked: Locus cannot update itself right now: {{reason}}

connection.toggleHint: Press Enter to turn the VPN on or off
connection.takingLonger: Still connecting. This can take a few seconds on a school network — you can stop and try again.

supportBlock.title: Any problem at all — email us.
supportBlock.middleman: Start with the person who sold you your code: they know your account and can usually fix it on the spot.
supportBlock.emailLead: If they cannot, or you bought your code yourself, email
supportBlock.emailNote: and describe the problem: what you were doing, the exact message the app showed, and the Device ID from your Account page. Short is fine — the message is the part that matters.
supportBlock.replyPromise: Every email is answered within 12 hours, not counting nighttime.
supportBlock.why: Locus is run by one person, so an email that names the error is something that can actually be fixed.
supportBlock.deviceIdHint: Include the Device ID from your Account page — it is the one thing that tells us which install you are using.

signOut.title: Signed in on this device
signOut.body: Signing out makes this computer forget your access key. Your subscription is not cancelled, and the time you have paid for keeps running.
signOut.confirmBody: Locus will forget your access key on this computer. This computer will stop working with Locus until you enter the key from your card again.
signOut.confirmMoving: If you are moving to a new computer, this is what you want.
signOut.confirmKeeps: Your subscription is not cancelled, and it will not be shortened.
signOut.signedOut: Signed out. This computer no longer holds your key.
signOut.signedOutReleased: Signed out. Your key has been released here and is ready for your next device.
signOut.signedOutOffline: Signed out on this computer. We could not reach Locus to record it — your key is still yours, and entering it on your next device will work.
signOut.signedOutFailed: Locus could not sign out. Nothing has changed on this device. Try again, and email us if it keeps happening.
signOut.deviceIdCopyFailed: Could not copy automatically — select the Device ID and copy it by hand.

connection.freeDataNearlyOut: {{used}} of {{total}} used — nearly out of free data
connection.freeDataThrottled: {{used}} of {{total}} used — free data is spent for this month
connection.freeDataThrottledUpgrade: Full is faster and unmetered. Ask the person who sold you your code about upgrading.

errors.noServices: No IP detection services are available
